entries.name: Conscripted Cleaver

counterPressure.note: A below-average blade every fight it does not land its one trick. The raw-stat half (might low, ferocity narrow) is deliberately unremarkable next to a straight cultivated-rarity roll; the hypnotic broadcast is the entire reason to carry it.

entries.notes: Compound name: adjective 'Conscripted' from themeAdjectivePools['rusted-legion'], base noun 'Cleaver' reused from nounPools['armament-primary.humanoid'] (the base type's own head noun — a compound-pattern unique is free to reuse it, the adjective is what makes it a different name). Control axis via atom.mesmerizing (status.apply, status hypno) — SHIPPED and a working UnityCc row per g-affliction.json's own note, unlike the kelp/ember/scalding branches this theme's sibling set avoided for the same reason. No element param anywhere, per the theme's avoid-elemental-magic rule.

entries.name: Keg of Requisition

counterPressure.note: One cleanse proc and a low fortitude line is a modest stat sheet at this rung; the value is in never carrying a status into the next exchange, not in the numbers.

entries.notes: Of-construct name: base 'Keg' reused from nounPools['core-guard.humanoid'] (the base type's own noun), concept 'Requisition' from conceptPools['rusted-legion']. Utility axis via atom.cleansing (status.clear, OnDamageTaken) — SHIPPED, no Unity-branch gap, per g-sustain.json. No element param.

entries.name: Scavenged Shrug

counterPressure.note: This shoulder piece was never issued proper plating: it forgoes the shield atom.warded would otherwise grant at this slot, at moderate severity, to pay for the muster tally instead.

entries.notes: Compound name: adjective 'Scavenged' from themeAdjectivePools['rusted-legion'], base noun 'Shrug' reused from nounPools['ward-array.humanoid'] (the base type's own noun). Economy axis via atom.econ-muster (resource.economy, OnSpawn, currency points) — the same family sets/rusted-legion.json's own 2-piece capability uses on 'Ranked Garrison', reused here on a fixed unique core rather than a set threshold: fixed core atoms are never drawn from the role pool (ssot-uniques.md §3.5 rung 2), so econ-muster's own roles list (girdle/jewel-major/jewel-minor only) does not gate it here. No element param.

entries.name: Lanyard of the Roster

counterPressure.note: The everyday stat line (ferocity low, might wide) is meant to read as ordinary next to a straight roll; the item is a below-average stat stick every fight but the one time its wearer dies.

entries.notes: Of-construct name: base 'Lanyard' reused from nounPools['jewel-major.humanoid'] (the base type's own noun), concept 'Roster' from conceptPools['rusted-legion'], with 'the' per the pattern's optional article. Offense axis via atom.dooming (board.action, op doom, OnDeath) — SHIPPED, the single biggest blast in the shipped board.action set (atom-family-library.md §3.5); held at 'high' rather than the family's own pool-default 'extreme' band, since a unique's fixed core is sized directly by its author (seed-contract.md §10), not drawn against a tier window. Tagged 'signature' as this partition's flagship. No element param.

entries.name: Weary Mask

counterPressure.note: A single periodic heal and a low fortitude line, narrowed further by the variance slot — the wearer outlasts a fight rather than shrugging any one hit off it.

entries.notes: Compound name: adjective 'Weary' from themeAdjectivePools['rusted-legion'], base noun 'Mask' reused from nounPools['sense.humanoid'] (the base type's own noun). Survivability axis via atom.regeneration (resource.delta, OnTimer) — SHIPPED, no gap, per g-sustain.json. No element param.

entries.name: Tread of Drill

counterPressure.note: A chance-based grave and a low fortitude line; the payoff is the ground it denies, not a bigger number on the wearer.

entries.notes: Of-construct name: base 'Tread' reused from nounPools['footing.humanoid'] (the base type's own noun), concept 'Drill' from conceptPools['rusted-legion'] — marching discipline as the control fiction. Control axis via atom.gravemaking (grid.spawn, gridItemType Grave, OnDeath) — LIVE-proven per atom-family-library.md §3.5; a grave underfoot is area denial, which is why this sits on the control axis even though the family's own file tags it 'utility'. No element param.

entries.name: Surplusward

counterPressure.note: The dispenser was built to purge, not to punch: it carries no offensive line at all, a slight cost against what a straight cultivated-rarity roll on this slot would otherwise give.

entries.notes: Fusion name: the whole-token atomic seed 'Surplusward' from uniqueSetSeedPools['rusted-legion'], used exactly as the exemplar's own 'Thornmantle' uses a seed word — never decomposed into 'surplus' + 'ward'. Utility axis via atom.sust-freshgraft (status.clear, OnSpawn) — SHIPPED, a self-cleanse the instant the wearer deploys, per g-sustain.json. No element param.

entries.name: Whistle of Duty

counterPressure.note: A single on-kill ledger tick and a low vitality line; the item pays out in a currency, not in the fight itself.

entries.notes: Of-construct name: base 'Whistle' reused from nounPools['retinue.humanoid'] (the base type's own noun), concept 'Duty' from conceptPools['rusted-legion']. Economy axis via atom.econ-bounty (resource.economy, OnDeath, currency points) — RUNTIME HONESTY: the write path is real and tested (g-economy.json's own capPerMatch finding against AtomKindRegistry/AtomRunner), but the 'points' currency has no confirmed downstream consumer yet, the same gap that family's own entry states. No element param.
